lines.zh: 摊位得往前挪，光才照得到货。
lines.en: The stall must move forward so light reaches the goods.

lines.zh: 我背着箱子，走得不快。
lines.en: I carry the crate and do not walk fast.

lines.zh: 晶体在包里互相碰，叮叮响。
lines.en: The crystals clink against each other in my bag.

lines.zh: 这条路我一天走两趟。
lines.en: I walk this road twice a day.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我赶着去开市。
lines.en: Do not block me; I am hurrying to open shop.

lines.zh: 石板路把我的鞋底磨薄了。
lines.en: The paving has worn my soles thin.

lines.zh: 我停在路口，看看今天的人流。
lines.en: I stop at the corner to gauge today's crowd.

lines.zh: 箱子里最贵的那块，我不敢晃。
lines.en: I dare not jostle the most expensive piece in the crate.

lines.zh: 走一段就歇一下，肩膀吃不消。
lines.en: I rest every stretch; my shoulder cannot take more.

lines.zh: 前面有个空摊位，位置不错。
lines.en: There is an empty stall ahead, in a good spot.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖在货箱后面。
lines.en: My shadow trails behind the goods crate.

lines.zh: 天没亮就得走，货得摆好。
lines.en: I leave before dawn so the goods are displayed.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，晶体怕磕。
lines.en: I soften my steps; crystals bruise easily.

lines.zh: 市场的声音越来越近了。
lines.en: The sound of the market is getting closer.

lines.zh: 我擦着一块晶体，等客人上门。
lines.en: I polish a crystal while waiting for customers.

lines.zh: 今天的价，我还没定好。
lines.en: I have not settled today's prices.

lines.zh: 我一个人守着摊子，习惯。
lines.en: I mind the stall alone; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在货上，我吹掉。
lines.en: Dust settles on the goods and I blow it off.

lines.zh: 中午人少，我打个盹。
lines.en: At midday few come, so I doze.

lines.zh: 我在算昨天的账，算了两遍。
lines.en: I tally yesterday's accounts twice.

lines.zh: 这块晶体有裂纹，得降价。
lines.en: This crystal has a crack; the price must drop.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人讨价还价。
lines.en: I hear haggling in the distance.

lines.zh: 秤砣有点歪，我调了一下。
lines.en: The scale weight sits crooked, so I adjust it.

lines.zh: 摊布旧了，但还能用。
lines.en: The stall cloth is old but still serviceable.

lines.zh: 我不急，买卖是等来的。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; trade comes to those who wait.

lines.zh: 箱子底下还有几块好货。
lines.en: There are a few good pieces under the crate.

lines.zh: 我在想，该不该进新货。
lines.en: I am wondering whether to stock something new.

lines.zh: 风把招牌吹得直响。
lines.en: The wind keeps rattling my sign.

lines.zh: 你站在摊前，先看货，再看我。
lines.en: You stand at the stall, eyeing goods, then me.

lines.zh: 你的钱袋鼓不鼓，我看得出来。
lines.en: I can tell how full your purse is.

lines.zh: 欢迎，随便看，别用手摸。
lines.en: Welcome, look freely, but do not touch.

lines.zh: 你眼睛停在那块蓝的上，好眼光。
lines.en: Your eyes rest on the blue one; good taste.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是因为你挡住了光。
lines.en: I look up because you are blocking my light.

lines.zh: 你是来买的，还是来问价的？
lines.en: Are you buying, or only asking prices?

lines.zh: 我看你的靴子，走了很远的路。
lines.en: Your boots tell me you walked a long way.

lines.zh: 你的手在袖子里，攥着什么？
lines.en: Your hand is in your sleeve; holding what?

lines.zh: 别急，货不会跑。
lines.en: No rush; the goods will not run off.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像矿洞。
lines.en: You smell like a mine shaft.

lines.zh: 我认得回头客，你是第三个。
lines.en: I know my regulars; you are the third today.

lines.zh: 你的目光在我箱子上停太久。
lines.en: Your gaze lingers on my crate too long.

lines.zh: 想还价，先笑一下。
lines.en: If you want a discount, smile first.

lines.zh: 我等你开口。
lines.en: I wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的手在货上停了一下。
lines.en: Your hand paused over the goods.

lines.zh: 我等你把价说出口。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to name a price.

lines.zh: 别打，我是做生意的！
lines.en: Stop, I am here to trade!

lines.zh: 这一下打在肩上，我弯了腰。
lines.en: That landed on my shoulder and I doubled over.

lines.zh: 我的货，我的货没碎吧？
lines.en: My goods, did any of my goods break?

lines.zh: 疼，但你得赔。
lines.en: It hurts, and you will pay for it.

lines.zh: 我往后退，撞到了箱子。
lines.en: I step back and hit the crate.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，经不起几下。
lines.en: Thirty health does not survive many blows.

lines.zh: 我捂着伤口，还在算损失。
lines.en: I clutch the wound and still count my losses.

lines.zh: 市场里不许动手，你不知道？
lines.en: No fighting in the market; did you not know?

lines.zh: 我记住了，你欠我一笔。
lines.en: I have noted it; you owe me one.

lines.zh: 打完我还是要开门做生意。
lines.en: After this, I still have to open for business.

lines.zh: 绿宝石？放桌上，别晃。
lines.en: Emeralds? Put them on the table and do not wave them.

lines.zh: 你这块原石成色不错。
lines.en: This rough stone of yours has good color.

lines.zh: 我对好东西没有抵抗力。
lines.en: I have no defense against good merchandise.

lines.zh: 让我看看，就看看。
lines.en: Let me look; only look.

lines.zh: 这个价，我有点心动。
lines.en: At that price, I am tempted.

lines.zh: 你手里的晶体，比我的亮。
lines.en: The crystal in your hand is brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 收下这个，我可以让一点价。
lines.en: Take this and I can shave the price a little.

lines.zh: 别拿假货试我，我摸得出。
lines.en: Do not test me with fakes; I can feel the difference.

lines.zh: 好东西要配好价钱。
lines.en: Good goods deserve a good price.

lines.zh: 我伸手了，说明我感兴趣。
lines.en: I am reaching out, which means I am interested.

lines.zh: 小心，别撞翻我的箱子。
lines.en: Careful, do not tip my crate.

lines.zh: 你踩到摊布了，抬脚。
lines.en: You are standing on my stall cloth; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，护住货。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and shield the goods.

lines.zh: 挤市场的人，都这样。
lines.en: Everyone crowds in a market; it happens.

lines.zh: 晶体掉了一块，我蹲下去捡。
lines.en: A crystal fell, so I crouch to pick it up.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我不生气，但价钱不变。
lines.en: Bump me and I stay calm, but the price stays too.

lines.zh: 我们侧身让过，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We turn sideways and pass without a word.

lines.zh: 箱子歪了，我扶正。
lines.en: The crate tilts and I set it straight.

lines.zh: 人多的时候，我把货往里挪。
lines.en: When it gets crowded, I pull the goods inward.

lines.zh: 碰撞声响，我先看晶体有没有碎。
lines.en: At the knock I check whether any crystal broke.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在另一条街摆摊。
lines.en: My partner keeps a stall on another street.

lines.zh: 我们隔三天见一次，交换货源。
lines.en: We meet every three days to swap stock.

lines.zh: 她算账比我快，我进货比她狠。
lines.en: She counts faster; I haggle harder for stock.

lines.zh: 婚礼上用的是我们自己卖的晶体。
lines.en: At our wedding we used crystals from our own stock.

lines.zh: 她总说我定价太软。
lines.en: She always says my prices are too soft.

lines.zh: 我们一起盘货，盘到半夜。
lines.en: We count inventory together until midnight.

lines.zh: 孩子出生后，摊子多了个小板凳。
lines.en: After the child came, the stall gained a small stool.

lines.zh: 她走后，我学会了自己记账。
lines.en: After she left, I learned to keep the books myself.

lines.zh: 两个人的摊，货能摆得更满。
lines.en: With two people, a stall can be stocked fuller.

lines.zh: 我们约好，明年换个大铺面。
lines.en: We agreed to take a bigger shop next year.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起掉在地上的硬币。
lines.en: I bend to pick up a coin from the ground.

lines.zh: 这块碎晶还能卖，别扔。
lines.en: This crystal chip still sells; do not toss it.

lines.zh: 客人的东西掉了，我叫住他。
lines.en: A customer dropped something and I call him back.

lines.zh: 我捡起货，先用布擦干净。
lines.en: I pick up goods and wipe them clean first.

lines.zh: 地上有枚铜币，我踩住了。
lines.en: There is a copper coin on the ground; I pin it with my foot.

lines.zh: 别人丢下的箱子，我先看看有没有名。
lines.en: A left crate — I check it for an owner's mark.

lines.zh: 捡东西要快，市场不等人。
lines.en: Pick things up fast; the market waits for no one.

lines.zh: 这块原石边角磕了，我叹气。
lines.en: This rough stone has a chipped corner; I sigh.

lines.zh: 我把散落的晶体一颗颗放回格子。
lines.en: I return the scattered crystals to their slots one by one.

lines.zh: 捡到的钥匙，我挂在摊边等人认领。
lines.en: A found key hangs by my stall for its owner.

lines.zh: 有人朝我的摊子走过来。
lines.en: Someone is walking toward my stall.

lines.zh: 那位客人看货很久了。
lines.en: That customer has studied the goods a long while.

lines.zh: 我注意到他的钱袋。
lines.en: His purse has caught my notice.

lines.zh: 一个新面孔，值得招呼。
lines.en: A new face, worth greeting.

lines.zh: 他手里拿着东西，像是要卖。
lines.en: He holds something, as if to sell.

lines.zh: 我抬高声音，喊了一句价。
lines.en: I raise my voice and call out a price.

lines.zh: 那位在别家问过价，又回来了。
lines.en: He priced elsewhere and came back.

lines.zh: 我锁定了一个好客人。
lines.en: I have picked out a good customer.

lines.zh: 他往这边看，我点头。
lines.en: He glances this way and I nod.

lines.zh: 生意来了，我把秤摆正。
lines.en: Business is coming; I straighten the scale.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的手，看他要拿哪块。
lines.en: I watch his hand to see which piece he takes.

lines.zh: 他犹豫，我就再让半价。
lines.en: He hesitates, so I knock off another half.

lines.zh: 我跟着他的目光，介绍货。
lines.en: I follow his gaze and describe the goods.

lines.zh: 他走到隔壁摊，我等。
lines.en: He drifts to the next stall; I wait.

lines.zh: 我把最好的那块往前推。
lines.en: I push the best piece forward.

lines.zh: 他问价，我笑着报数。
lines.en: He asks the price and I answer with a smile.

lines.zh: 他摸口袋，我知道成了。
lines.en: He touches his pocket, and I know it is done.

lines.zh: 我留了个位置，给他坐。
lines.en: I keep a seat free for him.

lines.zh: 他还想走，我加了一句。
lines.en: He still means to leave, so I add one more line.

lines.zh: 这一单，我不打算放。
lines.en: This sale, I do not intend to lose.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，货差点翻。
lines.en: I raise an arm to block and nearly upset the goods.

lines.zh: 别打我，我只是个商人。
lines.en: Do not hit me; I am only a merchant.

lines.zh: 我抡起秤杆，砸偏了。
lines.en: I swing the scale beam and miss.

lines.zh: 这一拳我用尽力气，也没什么用。
lines.en: I put all my strength in that punch, for nothing.

lines.zh: 我喊人，市场里有守卫。
lines.en: I shout for help; the market has guards.

lines.zh: 你还手？价钱翻倍。
lines.en: You strike back? That doubles your price.

lines.zh: 我退了，护着箱子往后。
lines.en: I retreat, guarding the crate behind me.

lines.zh: 别碰我的货，那是我全部家当。
lines.en: Do not touch my goods; they are all I own.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，但我记得你的脸。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I will remember your face.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我的摊子散了。
lines.en: After that blow, my stall is in pieces.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我把摊布铺开。
lines.en: Day breaks and I spread the stall cloth.

lines.zh: 箱子放下，晶体一块块摆好。
lines.en: The crate lands and crystals go out one by one.

lines.zh: 这条街今天第一个开张的是我。
lines.en: I am the first to open on this street today.

lines.zh: 我从货车上跳下来，鞋上都是土。
lines.en: I hop off the cart with dust all over my shoes.

lines.zh: 招牌挂歪了，我扶正。
lines.en: The sign hangs crooked, so I straighten it.

lines.zh: 市场还没热起来，我先擦货。
lines.en: The market is not busy yet, so I wipe the goods.

lines.zh: 我数了数，今天带了十二块。
lines.en: I count twelve pieces brought today.

lines.zh: 有人路过，我喊了第一声。
lines.en: Someone passes and I call out for the first time.

lines.zh: 开市前，我先给自己倒杯水。
lines.en: Before opening, I pour myself a cup of water.

lines.zh: 太阳照到摊子上，可以开始了。
lines.en: Sun reaches the stall; I can begin.

lines.zh: 火！先救货，人还能跑。
lines.en: Fire! Save the goods first; I can still run.

lines.zh: 我从货堆上滑下来，摔了腰。
lines.en: I slid off the crate stack and hurt my back.

lines.zh: 我不该走河边那条近路。
lines.en: I should not have taken the riverside shortcut.

lines.zh: 冲击把摊子掀了，晶体满地。
lines.en: The blast threw my stall down, crystals everywhere.

lines.zh: 谁在放箭？这里是市场！
lines.en: Who is shooting? This is a market!

lines.zh: 这股力量把我的价钱都打乱了。
lines.en: That force scrambled every price I had.

lines.zh: 守了一天摊，我还没吃饭。
lines.en: A whole day at the stall and I have not eaten.

lines.zh: 雷打在招牌上，我吓得蹲下。
lines.en: Lightning struck my sign and I crouched in fright.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，货也一起。
lines.en: I am falling, and the goods with me.
